consent.title: Consent & Privacy
consent.intro: Consent policy per site, coverage measured from real decisions, retention windows and data subject requests. Every change here is audited.
consent.siteContext: Policy, coverage and the simulator refer to {site}
consent.switchSiteHint: Change the site in the workspace switcher.
consent.noSiteText: Create your first site to get a consent policy, coverage figures and the impact simulator.

regionModeHelp.strict_opt_in: Nothing beyond strictly necessary processing runs until the visitor opts in.
regionModeHelp.opt_out: Analytics and marketing run until the visitor opts out. Only where the law allows it.
regionModeHelp.notice_only: A notice is considered sufficient. The pipeline still requires an explicit signal before it stores analytics or marketing events.

coverage.title: Consent coverage
coverage.intro: Measured from the consent states your stored events carried. Shares are weighted by events; nothing is estimated.
coverage.events: Events with a recorded consent state
coverage.explicitHint: Share of events with a CMP or API decision instead of the default state
coverage.marketingHint: After Global Privacy Control has been applied
coverage.gpcHint: Share of events carrying a GPC opt-out
coverage.stale: No new consent decision has been recorded since {date}. Check that the snippet is installed and events arrive.
coverage.emptyText: Coverage appears as soon as the snippet or the server API delivers events with a consent state. Until then nothing is measured, so nothing is shown.
coverage.tableCaption: Consent coverage per region group, weighted by stored events

policy.title: Policy for {site}
policy.intro: The published version drives the policy engine for every new event. Edit a draft, check it in the simulator and publish it deliberately.
policy.noPublished: No published version yet. The platform default applies: strict opt-in everywhere, advertising destinations require marketing consent.
policy.noDraft: No draft. Create one to change region modes, destination purposes or operational events.
policy.operationalHint: Stored as the merchant's own records even without analytics consent; identifiers are still withheld and nothing is sent to advertising without marketing consent.
policy.noChanges: No effective differences to the published version.

change.operationalRemoved: {event} is no longer an operational event

publishDialog.title: Publish consent policy v{version}?
publishDialog.description: The policy engine applies the published version to every new event within seconds. Previously published versions are archived as evidence.
publishDialog.weakerWarning: This version is less restrictive than the currently published one. Publishing it is your documented decision; Track does not assess whether it is lawful.

discardDialog.title: Discard draft v{version}?
discardDialog.description: The draft is archived and can no longer be edited or published.

editor.title: Edit draft v{version}
editor.intro: Only stricter settings apply silently. Anything less restrictive than the published version asks for your confirmation and a documented legal basis.
editor.destinationHelp: A destination can only be made stricter than its base purpose.
editor.noDestinations: No destinations on this site yet. Purposes can be tightened once a destination exists.
editor.legalNoteHelp: Required when a change is less restrictive (at least {min} characters). This is your own documentation, not legal advice from Track.

weakerDialog.title: Confirm a less restrictive policy
weakerDialog.description: These changes let the pipeline do more without consent than the published version does. Track does not assess whether that is lawful in your markets; document your legal basis below and confirm.

policies.title: All consent policies
policies.intro: Every version across the organization's sites, newest change first.
policies.empty: No consent policy yet. The setup assistant or the draft button creates one.
policies.caption: Consent policy versions of all sites

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Days per data kind for this organization (defaults from the platform policy). Shorter windows apply at the next retention run.

dsar.title: Data subject requests
dsar.text: Requests are processed against pseudonymous identifiers only: the e-mail is hashed before it is stored. Export produces a downloadable JSON, delete removes the subject's events and conversion records across the organization's sites.

errors.notFound: The policy could not be found.
errors.draftExists: This site already has an open draft.
errors.notDraft: Only a draft can be changed or published.
errors.confirmWeaker: A less restrictive policy needs your explicit confirmation.
errors.legalNote: Document the legal basis (at least {min} characters).
errors.purposeTooWeak: A destination cannot require less than its base purpose.

simulator.title: Consent Impact Simulator
simulator.intro: Runs the real policy engine on hypothetical events for a scenario you choose — region, consent state, signal, destination — before you publish.
simulator.disclaimer: The result shows what the Track policy engine would decide for events like these under the selected policy version. It says nothing about the vendor's own processing and does not assess whether a setting is lawful in your markets.

result.title: Result
result.gpcApplied: GPC opt-out applied: marketing and personalization removed
result.consentMode: Google Consent Mode v2 flags derived from this state
result.noDestinationsText: The simulation shows storage decisions only. Add a destination or pick a hypothetical one in the scenario to see forwarding decisions.
result.hypotheticalNote: Hypothetical: not connected on this site, evaluated as if it were connected.

table.caption: Decision per event and destination
table.noClickIds: no click IDs for this destination

result.fieldsIntro: The policy decides per group whether a field may be stored or forwarded — if the event carries it at all. The simulator does not know the real payload.

notes.1: Server events never bypass a missing browser consent for advertising purposes.
notes.2: Verified shop orders are stored as the merchant's own records, but identifiers are withheld and nothing is sent to advertising without marketing consent.
notes.3: Click IDs are only forwarded to the vendor they belong to and only while they are valid.
notes.4: AI-inferred values are never exported to advertising platforms.
notes.5: Paused, draft or erroring destinations receive nothing, whatever the consent state.

fields.commerce: order value, currency, order ID, items

share.title: Share this scenario
share.hint: The link contains the scenario only. Whoever opens it needs access to this site.
share.failed: Copying failed — select the link and copy it manually.
